title: Anti-ractopamine-pork New Year's Eve march and overnight camp continuing into Jan 1
possible_unit_owner: taiwan_2020-12; Dec 31 physical assembly and own-government policy target are directly reported with about 100 participants, but the prior-month coordinator should confirm coding compatibility and ownership
notes: TVBS pre-event S010 announces a Dec 31 gathering at Jingfu Gate. TVBS S005, published just after midnight, reports the alliance physically walked around the Legislative Yuan three times with about 100 people on Dec 31 while opposing Taiwan's pork-import policy. This is the reported prior-month physical assembly, domestic-state target, and qualitative threshold evidence; the December-onset claim is not based on the overnight camp alone. TVBS S001/S007 and NOWnews S008 describe the same alliance continuing from the overnight camp into Jan 1, with movement toward the Presidential flag ceremony and Executive Yuan; NOWnews says fewer than 100 but gives no lower bound. TVBS describes camp near Ketagalan/Jingfu Gate while NOWnews places it outside the Chang Yung-fa Foundation; preserve the conflict. Yahoo S019 is a separate search-only night-march hit and is not used for turnout. NOWnews reports participants disbanded after reaching the Executive Yuan. The Jan 1 activity is retained as a continuation, not a second January-start event; prior-month owner remains for coordinator review. The separate Nov 22 Autumn Struggle (S017) has no evidence of continuous physical presence to Dec 31 and is not merged.
